banScreenEnabled.description: Use Paradigm's formatted ban rejection screen.

banScreenLines.description: Formatted lines shown when Paradigm rejects a banned connection.

cacheRefreshSeconds.description: How often SQL-backed servers refresh active punishments from storage.

warnEscalationEnabled.description: Automatically create a temporary ban when a player reaches a configured warning threshold.

warnEscalationReason.description: Reason recorded on escalation bans. Supports {count}, {window}, {duration} and {player}.

warnEscalationRules.description: Escalation thresholds. Each rule counts non-revoked warnings inside its window and applies its ban duration.
